description: Single big-number cashback rate display. Three variants: 'band' (full-width primary band, used as a page CTA strip), 'card' (centered card, sidebar-friendly), 'split' (rate on left + description + CTA on right). Pair with StoreHero when the side card isn't enough.

description.hint: 1-2 sentence framing of what the rate means.

primaryCta.hint: Affiliate CTA — rel defaults to 'sponsored noopener'.

preview.description: Stack site-wide promo codes with our cashback on eligible hotels.
preview.note: Excludes refundable rates and certain partner hotels.
